phases.name: Vocab & Kanji Catch-Up Sprint

card.title: Phase 1 · Vocab & Kanji Catch-Up Sprint
card.focus: The mock's weakest section was Vocabulary at 59%, dragged down by Orthography and Word formation at 40% each. This phase exists to close that gap before anything else. Grammar and reading drop to maintenance so Anki and Kanji Dojo get the time. Immersion stays exactly as it is — it's already carrying Listening to 81%.

phases.name: Build-Up & Reading Focus
phases.focus: New-item pace tapers, reading gets the extra time

card.title: Phase 2 · Build-Up & Reading Focus
card.focus: Once the vocab and kanji backlog is under control, new-item pace tapers and the freed-up time moves to Reading — the second-weakest section at 52%, mostly from Reading comprehension (33%) and Short passages (40%). Grammar work narrows to Sentence composition and Text grammar, the two subskills that pulled Grammar down to 62%. Weekly sectional mocks start here.

card.title: Phase 3 · Exam Simulation
card.focus: No new material. Pure reinforcement and exam conditioning — full mocks every week, reading under real timing, and listening without subtitles. Listening is already the strongest section at 81%, so the goal here is just to keep it sharp, not rebuild it.

footerNotes: This plan resets from the Sept 20 mock (119.8/180, passed) — Phase 1 exists specifically to close the Vocabulary gap (59%, driven by Orthography and Word formation at 40% each) before Migii mocks resume in Phase 2.
Listening was already the strongest section at 81% — immersion time isn't being reallocated, since it's clearly working.

The daily new-item paces above are ballpark figures, not official counts — JLPT hasn't published exact vocab/kanji lists since the 2010 revision. Adjust to match your actual Anki deck and Kanji Dojo course size.
Missed a day? Fold it into the weekend block rather than doubling up the next day — consistency beats cramming, especially during the Phase 1 sprint.
Today's checklist is saved on this device only, and resets each new day automatically.
